Load and validate control parameters (VFDs, EC fans, valves, pumps). Develop automated functional, pressure, and leak testing. Validate control sequences, interlocks, and fault simulation. Own PLC/HMI and safety logic (Rockwell or Siemens). Develop automated test systems using LabVIEW or equivalent platforms. Enable MES integration and data traceability. Identify and deliver hard savings (labor, scrap, uptime, FPY). Develop CapEx business cases and payback analysis. Lead suppliers and integrators through RFQ, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and handoff. Apply Lean tools (Standard Work, SMED, Poka‑Yoke, 5 Why, 8D). Execute projects using Gantt, risk mitigation, and change control. Integrate safety by design and maintain robust quality documentation. Requirements We are looking for proactive, data-driven, and hands-on engineers with strong ownership and execution mindset. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 5–7 years delivering automation in a manufacturing environment (design → commissioning → sustain) with measurable results. Proven track record of validated business cases and hard savings (labor, scrap, uptime, FPY). Advanced English (written and spoken) Practical experience with layout, line balancing, Standard Work, SMED, and Poka-Yoke. Project management experience using Gantt charts, risk management, and change control. Valid visa. Preferred Qualifications (Plus) Experience with AHU (Air Handling Units) assembly and/or CDU/LCU (Coolant Distribution Units) for data centers. Experience with automated pressure, leak, and functional testing systems. Experience integrating MES, traceability, and industrial data collection systems. Lean / Six Sigma certification or strong continuous improvement leadership experience. Benefits We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees. Comprehensive health insurance for peace of mind and well-being Professional development and career growth opportunities Our commitment to you Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees.
